Class ProgressRing

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
net.tessel.fx.components.ProgressRing
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class ProgressRing extends javafx.scene.layout.Region
A circular progress indicator. Indeterminate by default; give it a progress between 0 and 1 for a determinate ring. ProgressState turns it paused (warning), failed (danger) or finished (success). 
ProgressRing busy = new ProgressRing(32);
ProgressRing half = new ProgressRing(48); half.setProgress(0.5);
